item.title: These Virginia Black-owned restaurants are offering 'pay what you can' menus this week
item.description: A Black-owned restaurant outreach effort that's only in its second year has doubled in size and support across Virginia.

item.title: Woman struck in hit-and-run in downtown Richmond
item.description: A driver struck a pedestrian in a hit-and-run Monday evening at the intersection of Cary and 2nd Street in downtown Richmond, according to a woman who captured the crash on her security camera.

item.title: Richmond Flying Squirrels host job fairs ahead of CarMax Park opening season
item.description: The Richmond Flying Squirrels have been gearing up for their inaugural season at CarMax Park with a series of job fairs, offering part-time and seasonal positions.
